reason: I always get three quotes from local firms and go with the middle one, and a lone freelancer in Kuwait with no UK clients or reviews wouldn't even make my shortlist. Pay-when-happy is nice, but my worry isn't the deposit, it's who picks up when the site breaks in two years.
objection: He's in Kuwait, not Manchester, with no UK track record. Will he actually finish it, and will he still be answering my WhatsApps when something goes wrong after launch?
would_change_my_mind: A couple of Manchester business owners I could actually ring who'd say he built their site and still looks after it, plus a written response time for fixes on the care plan.
